items.note: The Overview calls the product a B2B note-taking app and the whole PRD is written for that product.
The Overview says the document is for engineering and design leads to review at kickoff. The tone fits that audience.
Requirements cover creating a workspace, inviting members by email and shared notes.
Requirements 10–11 limit v1 to the admin and member roles.
The non-goals list billing changes, SSO and guest access as out of scope for v1.
The primary metric is stated exactly: 20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days. When the 60-day window starts is correctly listed as an open question.
The document runs about 900 words, roughly two pages. It's near the limit, and the closing assumptions list repeats the in-body assumptions, but it stays within 'about 2 pages'.
Open question 1 covers migration of existing shared notes. It says the question is left open on purpose and proposes no answer.
